recipe.select: lowest dev greedy mean CER (historical dev set, against the mined references), then highest dev greedy top-1 exact agreement (family macro), then the earlier update; eligible: the registered checkpoints and, if the run stops early, the final state
recipe.input: lower-cased English word as UTF-8 bytes + EOS (unchanged from E06); no pronunciation, no prefix
fixes: max_new_tokens 121 with a no_eos status (latent E06 defect)
LoRA wrapper exposes the frozen base weight so FFN layers can be adapted
metrics: top-4 oracle at equal beam-4 budget
distinct top-1 and most frequent share
recipe.rationale: From the audit and the passed tiny gate: the pipeline can learn input-dependent outputs, so E06's collapse is an adaptation limitation. Kept from the tiny diagnostic: FFN + attention adapters (capacity; PEFT notes all-linear targeting can approach full fine-tuning) and lr 1e-3. Changed from E06: FFN targets, 3x the updates and 2x the batch (about 43 epochs vs 7) so cross-attention has time to learn the mapping before the schedule decays. Kept from E06 for generalisation on 2,255 noisy mined pairs: base dropout 0.1 and adapter dropout 0.05 (zero dropout was only for memorisation). Linear decay to 0 after a 100-update warm-up.

select.e11: highest dev greedy top-1 macro (exact reference agreement, NFC), then lower dev mean CER, then earlier update
select.e12: lowest dev greedy mean CER (historical dev set, against the mined references), then highest dev greedy top-1 exact agreement (family macro), then the earlier update; eligible: the registered checkpoints and, if the run stops early, the final state

init: pinned google/byt5-small base + fresh LoRA adapter (seed 0); a fresh 6,000-update schedule, not a resume of E11's exhausted scheduler; nothing from E08/E10/E11 adapters

exposure.sampling: row-level: each epoch a seeded permutation of all optimisation rows (E07's e07.fit default); a word with k spellings is drawn k times per epoch; no source weighting

guard: stop (resumable) after 3 consecutive readings with process RSS > 6.5 GiB or MemAvailable < 0.4 GiB
selection: lowest dev greedy mean CER (historical dev set, against the mined references), then highest dev greedy top-1 exact agreement (family macro), then the earlier update; eligible: the registered checkpoints and, if the run stops early, the final state
selection_note: an explicitly imperfect automatic surrogate (mined references), chosen so the run can finish unattended; it does not select for phonetic quality; owner dev judgments are diagnostic only and never rank checkpoints

evaluation.decoding: greedy for E12 and E11 (identical encoding, length limit, normalisation)
evaluation.historical: dev and eval exact agreement and CER, paired family bootstrap, validity, missing endings, length bins, error kinds (exploratory; no tuning or further run may follow from them)
evaluation.dev_judgment_coverage: E12 dev outputs equal to an owner-judged E11-review candidate take that judgment; others are reported as unknown

analysis.primary: paired difference E12 − E11 in owner-confirmed top-1 acceptability on the 120 test families: share of items whose greedy output is judged `acceptable` (denominator: all 120 items; `uncertain` and `not_acceptable` count as not confirmed)
analysis.per_item_judgment: each model takes the judgment of the candidate equal to its greedy output; identical outputs are shown once and share one judgment; an empty output counts as not_acceptable (policy rule 9)
report: acceptable / not_acceptable / uncertain counts per model
uncertainty rate per model and share of items with any uncertain judgment
paired table: both acceptable, E12 only, E11 only, neither (primary coding)
family-level paired bootstrap 95% interval of the primary difference (10,000, seed 20261027; one item per family)
two-sided exact binomial (McNemar) test on discordant clear pairs: one model acceptable and the other not_acceptable; pairs with an uncertain judgment are not in this test
sensitivity: items with any uncertain judgment excluded (denominator: items with two clear judgments)
analysis.completeness: scored only when every candidate of every item has an explicit judgment; blanks are missing, never acceptance
analysis.interpretation: a non-significant difference is not equivalence; one non-independent judge; results hold for this sample and policy
analysis.isolation: no test judgment enters training or checkpoint choice in this cycle
